div.head: VI Atr Lat 22.1
div.ab: K. Dominicę sollempnia diei cum summo honore magnopere celebranda sunt; nec quicquam in eadem operis agatur seruilis; negotia quoque secularia questionesque publice in eadem deponantur die.
div.note: Latin paraphrase of VI Atr (early 11th c.; K = Cotton Claudius A III f. 30, perhaps by Archbishop Wulfstan), text in column K (Liebermann’s text; until October 2026 in column T). Liebermann gives no German translation for it: for the meaning see the matching Old English chapter of VI Atr above, which it paraphrases (Liebermann prints in small type the words that correspond exactly to the Old English).; T: corrected against Gesetze I, October 2026 (was “(Liebermann’s Latin Paraphrase)”, now “∅ (moved to K)”)

note.seg: Weltliche, namentlich wohl landwirtschaftliche, Arbeit gilt also dem Lateiner als unfrei; vgl. Gl Fron 12
Secular work, probably agricultural work in particular, is thus regarded by the Latin writer as servile; cf. Gl Fron 12
